# FIND

> FIND is a remote-job aggregator that scrapes multiple remote-friendly job boards and surfaces fresh openings with direct application links — no third-party recruiters in the middle.

FIND helps remote workers discover and save jobs across multiple boards in one place, with a free tier and an optional PRO plan that unlocks unlimited exports, more saved-search boards, and AI-assisted job parsing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and scrape remote jobs across supported boards.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How user data is collected, stored, and used.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing the use of FIND.

## Optional
